title: The route north · the bend
logline: 101's bends past Newport, page by page, to Seattle. He never drove it. The Greyhound's road, drawn.

panels.composition: A bend of Highway 101 north of Newport, drawn from a map and memory of the map: the road climbing a headland, a guardrail, the Pacific enormous on the left, and painted on the road's shoulder — small — the shadow of a bus that isn't in the frame. No people. The page's ochre is the road's centerline.

image.prompt: a bend of a two-lane coastal highway climbing a headland with a guardrail and the enormous Pacific to the left, and on the road's shoulder the shadow of a bus that is not in the frame, spare ink with slate and sea-foam watercolor, no panel borders, no words
image.notes: One of thirty route pages. The bus is only ever a shadow.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: He leaves the town on paper. The bus is a shadow all the way to Seattle.
